an6.77:1.1: Cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.77:1.3: Muṭṭhasaccaṃ, asampajaññaṃ, indriyesu aguttadvārataṃ, bhojane amattaññutaṃ, kuhanaṃ, lapanaṃ.
an6.77:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātuṃ. 3.
